body:
web/src/App.tsx ProtectedRoute redirects to /login without preserving the
original location, and LoginPage always navigates to "/" after success. A
logged-out user opening an invite's "redeem in browser" URL
(/redeem?token=XYZ) or any deep link ends up dumped at the overview with the
token/URL silently lost — the web twin of Android's T-28.

Fix (small): pass the attempted location through the redirect
(<Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location }} />), and in LoginPage
navigate(state?.from ?? "/") on success. Add a test mirroring
OverviewPage.test.tsx patterns. Web is the fallback client, hence p3, but
this specifically breaks the invite-onboarding path for brand-new users,
who are exactly the people least equipped to recover.
title: Web: login flow drops the intended destination (incl. /redeem?token=...)
